name: Extra Venomborn Mutation
body:
Whether it appeared immediately or only later over time, the venomborn mutagen has given you more mutations than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Mutation species trait, venomborn.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional mutation, chosen from those listed for the mutation species trait.

Special: You can take this feat one additional time for every 6 levels you gain beyond 1st (7th, 13th, and 19th).
